item.text: {"iteration":6,"pcvs":[{"name":"default_tokenization","expression":"1 if prompts.gi_frame.f_locals.get('tokenization_kwargs') is None else 0","rationale":"Separates the initial call and its substantial initialization cost."},{"name":"request_count","expression":"len(params)","rationale":"Tracks common rendering and engine-insertion work per request."},{"name":"total_prompt_characters","expression":"0 if prompts.gi_frame.f_locals.get('tokenization_kwargs') is None else sum(len(p['prompt'] if 'prompt' in p else p) for p in prompts.gi_frame.f_locals['.0'].gi_frame.f_locals['self'].iterable)","rationale":"Measures actual batch text size, including variations that the first-prompt approximation missed, without consuming the rendering generator."},{"name":"prompt_word_work","expression":"0 if prompts.gi_frame.f_locals.get('tokenization_kwargs') is None else sum((p['prompt'] if 'prompt' in p else p).count(' ') + 1 for p in prompts.gi_frame.f_locals['.0'].gi_frame.f_locals['self'].iterable)","rationale":"Provides a cheap lexical-unit estimate for tokenization work, distinguishing texts with different word lengths."}],"hypothesis":"Exact batch character counts and a simple word-count estimate should explain tokenizer work more accurately than prompt-length categories, especially for heterogeneous short prompts and the final batch's modified prefixes."}
